thread:
Tom SRE: noticing a sudden spike in inference errors from the hosted API, p95 latency jumped to ~2.3s and error rate to ~4% across gen models. Paging Priya. Can someone confirm impact?
incident-bot: alert created: INC-1978012345 - Inference service errors > 3% for 5m. Pager sent to Priya Oncall. War room: https://zoom.redwood/warroom/INC-1978012345 
Priya Oncall: on it, joining war room now. @Tom SRE can you paste the top logs or a quick curl that reproduces?
Tom SRE: sharing quick curl that shows 503s: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -i``` headers show several 503s and backend errors referencing kv-cache timeouts.
Alice Eng: I'm seeing elevated queue depth on GPU pool gpool-3 and a bunch of RunnerOOMs in the runtime logs. Dumping recent scheduler metrics to the war room.
Priya Oncall: confirmed paging to oncall rotation. I've taken primary ownership for mitigation. Current action: 1) scale down high-latency models, 2) route traffic to fallback region until we stabilize. Executing canary now.
eng-oncall-bot: runbook lookup: "Inference KV cache timeout" -> https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-timeout. Recommend step: reduce continuous batching window and restart runner process.
Tom SRE: quick mitigation applied: decreased continuous_batch_ms from 40 -> 20 on gpool-3. Observed immediate drop in p95 to ~1.1s but errors still ~1.2%.
Priya Oncall: draft for status page (please review): ```We are experiencing elevated error rates and increased latency for the Redwood hosted inference API. Some requests may receive 5xx errors or delayed responses. We are investigating and have mitigations in progress. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate. Updates will follow here.``` Approve to post?
Dave PM: approve. Add estimated scope: "impacts a subset of production customers using gen models, not embeddings. No data loss." Also add ETA for next update in 15 mins.
Marta Support: prepping customer-facing blurb for CS teams: "We're aware of higher error rates for text generation. Engineers are mitigating; you may see retries succeed. We'll notify when service returns to normal." Will push to Support channel once status page posted.
Priya Oncall: posting status now and pinging paid-customers list. statuspage redwood.statuspage.io/incidents/INC-1978012345 posted.
incident-bot: status page updated at 1978012390: Investigating -> Updates in 15m. Notifying subscribers.
Alice Eng: running a controlled restart of two runners on gpool-3 (rolling restart). Monitoring logs. If errors drop under 0.5% for 5 mins, we'll consider partial resolution.
Tom SRE: note for handoff later: if errors resurface after restart, escalate to runtime lead (Alice) and consider fallback to quantized model variants.
Priya Oncall: confirms handoff plan. If I need to step out at 1978012600 I'll hand to Tom SRE. For now I'll stay in war room until we hit stable metrics.
Tom SRE: I acknowledge. I'll prepare post-incident notes template and impact assessment draft: - root cause hypothesis: KV cache eviction or scheduler overload - customer impact: 10-15% of requests to gen models saw 5xx or >1.5s latency - remediation steps taken: reduced batching, rolling restarts, routing changes - follow-ups: add better autoscaling triggers for gpool CPU/queue depth.
Marta Support: CS notified, created internal message for enterprise accounts. Will escalate to any customers reporting incidents.
eng-oncall-bot: paging confirmation: Priya Oncall acknowledged at 1978012412.
Priya Oncall: marking action items in the war room task list. I'll update incident channel when we move to "Identified" or "Mitigated". Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
